title: Module 2: Governance Frameworks — NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, UNESCO
description: Compare the three dominant AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, UNESCO Recommendation) and ISO/IEC 42001, identify where they overlap and disagree, and apply a practitioner workflow that uses each in combination.

learning_objectives.statement: State the four core functions of the NIST AI RMF (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage) and apply them to a deployment
Categorize an AI system under the EU AI Act risk tiers (prohibited, high-risk, limited-risk, minimal-risk, GPAI)
Identify three principles where UNESCO's Recommendation extends beyond the technical scope of NIST and the EU Act (sustainability, equity, AI literacy)
Apply a practitioner workflow that picks a primary framework and uses the others as cross-checks

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
